## Details

### `ddsim.condor`

- **Status:** Authoritative
- **Purpose:** Condor submit description for DDSim single-particle gun-production jobs.
- **Inputs:** scripts/condor_ddsim.sh, scripts/stamp_ddsim_metadata.py, per-job params/job_*.json files, scripts/queue_items.txt, compact DD4hep XML, and EOS output directory macro OUT_DIR.
- **Outputs:** DDSim EDM4hep ROOT gun samples staged to OUT_DIR/eta_<eta>/gun_eta<eta>_pt<pt>.root by scripts/condor_ddsim.sh; Condor stdout/stderr/log files under logs/.
- **Collections:** Produced ROOT files are DDSim/EDM4hep event files; downstream reco expects DCHCollection and related SimTrackerHit collections according to the selected compact geometry.
- **Tags:** authoritative, condor, ddsim, eos, eta-grid, gun-production, pt-grid, upstream, xrootd
- **Notes:** This is the authoritative submit description for the maintained DDSim gun-production Condor pipeline., The normal workflow is prepare_and_submit.sh -> ddsim.condor -> condor_ddsim.sh -> EOS gun samples., The queue is driven by scripts/queue_items.txt, which must list per-job JSON basenames already present under params/., Condor transfers only small control files and wrappers; DDSim writes locally on the worker and condor_ddsim.sh stages final ROOT outputs to EOS with xrdcp., Do not rely on Condor output-file transfer for the generated ROOT files; when_to_transfer_output is only for normal job-side files/log handling., If TRANSFER_COMPACT=1 is used by prepare_and_submit.sh, COMPACT_XML_ARG should be the transferred XML basename and the XML must be appended to transfer_input_files at submit time., If TRANSFER_COMPACT=0, COMPACT_XML_ARG should be the full EOS compact XML path readable by the worker., Generated gun samples are upstream inputs to the reco pipeline and should not be mixed into active source/config directories.

**Examples**

- cd /afs/cern.ch/user/c/cglenn/FCCWork/k4RecTracker/Tracking/test/testTrackFinder
- condor_submit \
- -a "OUT_DIR=/eos/user/c/cglenn/gun_samples/1_29_2026/25umCF_0.2umNiP_1.2umAu" \
- -a "COMPACT_XML_ARG=/eos/user/c/cglenn/FCCWork/GithubRepos/k4geoMax/FCCee/IDEA/compact/IDEA_o1_v03/IDEA_o1_v03_25umCF_0.2umNiP_1.2umAu.xml" \
- configs/condor/ddsim.condor

### `reco.condor`

- **Status:** Authoritative
- **Purpose:** Fixed submit description for reco jobs.
- **Inputs:** queuefile containing one input ROOT path per line, scripts/reco_job.sh, runtime.tgz from scripts/make_runtime.sh, scripts/stamp_pipeline_metadata.py, compact DD4hep XML, optional matching TGeo ROOT file, and EOS-readable DDSim gun samples.
- **Outputs:** Reco ROOT files staged by reco_job.sh to outdir/<eta_dir>/reco_<input>.root, optional failure logs under outdir/<eta_dir>/logs/, and HTCondor stdout/stderr/log files under scripts/logs/reco/.
- **Collections:** Does not inspect collections directly; worker jobs normally run DCHCollection -> DCHDigi2Collection/DCH_DigiCollection -> CDCHTracks/GGTF products -> GenFitTracks through steering/runDCHTestTrackFinder.py.
- **Tags:** authoritative, condor, dch, eos, genfit2, ggtf, key4hep, reco, submission, worker-queue, xrootd
- **Notes:** This is the authoritative submit description for the maintained reco Condor pipeline., The normal workflow is submit_reco.sh -> reco.condor -> reco_job.sh -> EOS reco outputs., runtime.tgz must be current before submission; rebuild it with scripts/make_runtime.sh after changes to k4RecTracker libraries, GenFit2, steering, catalogs, or model.onnx., Logging paths are on AFS/local storage because EOS is not appropriate for Condor submit/log files., transfer_output_files is intentionally empty because reco_job.sh stages physics ROOT outputs to EOS explicitly with xrdcp., For material comparisons, compactxml and tgeofile must correspond to the same detector/material variant, and all reco/analysis knobs should be kept fixed between variants., Defaults in this file are concrete campaign defaults; submit_reco.sh normally overrides them with -append values for the active campaign., Stale EOS reco outputs are skipped by reco_job.sh, so delete old outputs before rerunning changed configurations.

**Examples**

- cd /afs/cern.ch/user/c/cglenn/FCCWork/k4RecTracker/Tracking/test/testTrackFinder/scripts
- condor_submit reco.condor \
- -append "queuefile=$(pwd)/filelist.txt" \
- -append "outdir=/eos/user/c/cglenn/reco_samples2/1_29_2026/100umCF_0.313474umAu" \
- -append "compactxml=/eos/user/c/cglenn/FCCWork/GithubRepos/k4geoMax/FCCee/IDEA/compact/IDEA_o1_v03/IDEA_o1_v03_100umCF_0.313474umAu.xml" \
- -append "fitter=genfit2" \
- -append "usemat=1" \
- -append "stage=fit" \
- -append "fitout=auto" \
- -append "k4rel=2026-04-22" \
- -append "tgeofile=/afs/cern.ch/user/c/cglenn/FCCWork/k4RecTracker/Tracking/test/testTrackFinder/IDEA_o1_v03_100umCF_0.313474umAu.root"
